headlines.title: Pope Leo slept well after cancer surgery, but recovery could take ‘longer than expected’
headlines.description: VATICAN CITY — Pope Leo XIV’s recovery from lung surgery could take “longer than expected,” the president of Peru warned Wednesday, as the leader of the Roman Catholic Church continued to mend at Rome’s Gemelli Hospital.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: CVS to Pay $315 Million Settlement Over Opioid Prescriptions
headlines.description: CVS has agreed to pay a $315 million settlement to resolve a Justice Department case over allegations it illegally filled opioid prescriptions. The settlement resolves a 2024 lawsuit accusing the healthcare giant of providing controlled substances to fuel its own profits at the expense of public health and safety. CVS says it disagrees with all claims made and does not admit any wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Busy Philipps Talks ‘Cupertino,’ Brain Tumor Surgery, Motherhood
headlines.description: Actor Busy Philipps joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to discuss her new series “Cupertino” and opens up about finding out she had a brain tumor on the same day she landed the role. Busy shares how she felt “divinely protected” by her late best friend Kate and her “Dawson’s Creek” co-star James Van Der Beek, and also describes how her daughters navigated the health scare with her. Then, Busy sticks around to play a game of Get a Clue!

headlines.title: How to Bring Joy Into Your Life by Embracing the Micro Moments
headlines.description: Stanford University psychologist and lecturer Kelly McGonigal joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to discuss the power of harnessing joy in your everyday life, a lesson studied in depth in her new book "Joy Is a Risk Worth Taking." She also shares the importance of maintaining habits that bring you joy, delves into methods to bring more joy into your life and explains how to combat unwanted feelings of anxiety or guilt. "We don't have to wait for huge events in our life to feel joy," McGonigal says.

headlines.title: Pope Leo XIV Found to Have Lung Cancer During Surgery
headlines.description: Well wishes are pouring in for Pope Leo XIV after the 71-year-old pontiff was diagnosed with lung cancer during surgery to remove a nodule on his lung on Tuesday. The Vatican stated that doctors confirmed a diagnosis of pulmonary adenocarcinoma via tissue testing following pre-operative examinations. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports and medical contributor Dr. John Torres joins TODAY to share his perspective on treatment, recovery and how family history plays a role.

headlines.title: Do you actually need pet laundry detergent to clean your dog’s things?
headlines.description: Pet laundry detergents are on the rise, but are they different from regular detergent? Veterinarians explain whether your dog or cat really needs it.

headlines.title: This Crock-Pot slow cooker is on sale for under $40 just in time for soup season
headlines.description: Soup and stew season is here, and the family-size Crock-Pot 7-quart slow cooker is 40% off on Amazon. Here’s why it’s a great time to buy.

headlines.title: How to clean hardwood floors without ruining them
headlines.description: We found the best methods for cleaning hardwood floors that won’t end up ruining them in the process. Plus, cleaning experts recommended the best products for cleaning hardwood floors.

headlines.title: I test dozens of women’s walking shoes every year — these are the best ones for every foot type
headlines.description: NBC Select staffers put dozens of women's walking shoes to the test. Here are the options that came out on top from Hoka, NoBull, Saucony and more.

headlines.title: Megan Thee Stallion Says This Glute Workout Keeps Her ‘Sitting Like a Shelf’
headlines.description: Megan Thee Stallion revealed her favorite glute workout in a recent interview. She calls it a traditional move, but it’s an effective one that isolates the muscle.
